chunks: And ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam narrated from Muḥammad ibn Manṣūr al-Ṣayqal, from his father, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.
Concerning a man who divorces his wife while she is pregnant.

He said: "He may divorce her." I said: "Then may he take her back?" He said: "Yes, he may take her back." I said: "If it then occurs to him, after he has taken her back, to divorce her?" He said: "No, not until she gives birth."

key_terms.امْرَأَتَهُ: his wife; the spouse in the legal ruling
key_terms.بَدَا لَهُ: it occurred to him; he decided afterward
key_terms.تَضَعَ: she gives birth; delivery marking the relevant legal limit here
key_terms.فَيُرَاجِعُهَا: then he takes her back; revokes the divorce during the waiting period
key_terms.يُطَلِّقُ: he divorces; issuing divorce to the wife

ai.seo_question: Can a man divorce his pregnant wife again after taking her back?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the divorce of a pregnant wife. It states that she may be divorced and then taken back in revocable divorce, but if he has taken her back, he may not divorce her again until she gives birth.
